name: MedBrowseComp
description: MedBrowseComp is a benchmark designed to evaluate an agent's ability to retrieve and synthesize multi-hop medical facts from live, domain-specific knowledge bases. It contains over 1,000 human-curated questions reflecting real clinical scenarios requiring integration of fragmented or conflicting information.
reputation: A new medical retrieval benchmark that is promising for agentic search and synthesis, but it has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: Focuses on reliable medical information seeking from live knowledge bases; exposes performance gaps in current agentic systems.
